answers.core: It would provide a greater range of utility when creating applications in Godot, however I could see this feature as an add-on in the asset library rather than part of the core Godot editor.
answers.workaround: This could possibly be worked around with an extension that uses an external C++ library to access the media overlay, however I have not found such a library.

title: Add support for accessing the Media Overlay on Mobile & Windows
